headline: SMEDA and Alibaba.com Launch SME Grant Programme in Pakistan
summary: SMEDA and Alibaba.com are launching an SME grant program to support Pakistani businesses in adopting digital solutions and accessing international markets.
why: Digital export initiatives help small and medium enterprises overcome logistical barriers and expand cross-border e-commerce revenue streams.
